fyp_description: A full baseball analytics dashboard designed for CPBL fans, scouts, and analysts. Features include real-time scraping, dynamic statistics pages, player trends, API integration, and advanced data visualization. Built with modular front-end components and optimized JSON pipelines for fast loading.
fyp_overview: ProBall Analytics is a long-term development initiative focusing on building a complete baseball information system for CPBL. The platform integrates multiple systems:
fyp_pipeline: Static data processing pipeline using Python (XML → JSON → Supabase).
fyp_scraping: Dynamic scraping engine for real-time matchup and player updates.
fyp_frontend: Full front-end architecture built with modular JavaScript, reusable UI patterns, and performance-optimized rendering.
fyp_visualizations: Data visualizations including trend charts, histograms, and comparison diagrams.
fyp_scalability: The system is designed for scalability, supporting future expansion into mobile apps, AI-driven chat assistants, and predictive models. This project showcases both engineering depth—data pipelines, automation, API routes—and design consistency through a clean user interface.
fyp_goal: You can explore progress updates, demos, and detailed documentation through the project page. The goal is to provide one of the most complete independent CPBL analytics platforms built at a university level.
fyp_demo_description: This video demonstrates a preview showcase of the ProBall Analytics project, including UI navigation, data visualization, and user workflow examples.
